ops.old: Marshmallows toasted golden over the flame, squashed between graham-style biscuits with milk chocolate and a spoon of salted caramel. Make the caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt and cool. Lay 16 digestive or wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top 8 with a square of milk chocolate (100g total). Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden. Push 2 onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.
